transcript:
Meeting: Umbrella Bio QBR / Private deployment check-in
Recorded: 2025-02-20 3:00 PM ET
Duration: 41 minutes
Attendees: Avery Johnson (Redwood), Connor O'Brien (Redwood), Dana Wu (Umbrella Bio), Samir Nair (Umbrella Bio), Kelsey Hart (Umbrella Bio)

Summary (auto):
Umbrella Bio reviewed usage growth in their Private deployment and raised concerns about audit log completeness for admin actions. Redwood shared that Engineering is investigating event drops under backpressure and discussed mitigation and upcoming hotfix.

Transcript:
[00:00] Avery Johnson: Cool, thanks everyone for joining. We can do a quick QBR and then I wanted to make sure we leave time for the security questions Samir sent.
[00:18] Dana Wu: Yep sounds good. Overall performance is good. The one thing we saw was, uh, on the audit export, it looks like not every admin action shows up.
[00:34] Connor O'Brien: When you say admin action, do you mean RBAC changes in the console? API key creation?
[00:39] Samir Nair: Both. Specifically role binding changes. We cross-check from our internal change ticketing and the Redwood export has fewer events for a couple windows last week.
[01:02] Avery Johnson: Got it. Is this Private in your VPC, correct?
[01:05] Dana Wu: Yes, Private. Audit sink is HTTP push to our collector.
[01:14] Connor O'Brien: That matches something we've been looking at. There's a path where the audit-event router can drop events if the downstream is slow and we hit backpressure.
[01:30] Samir Nair: Thatsthats not great for us. We need a complete audit trail.
[01:35] Connor O'Brien: Totally. Mitigation is to increase the buffer and apply a hotfixwe have 1.14.4 going out. The hard part is if events were dropped, we can't reconstruct them unless the source system has them.
[02:01] Kelsey Hart: Soquestionis this isolated to us or a broader issue?
[02:06] Avery Johnson: Weve heard similar reports from at least a couple private customers. Were treating it seriously and well provide an incident write-up.
[02:21] Dana Wu: Okay. We'll send you examples.
[02:26] Connor O'Brien: Please include the UTC timestamp and the action type. Also your control plane version.
[03:05] Samir Nair: Do you have an SLA or guarantee around audit logging?
[03:10] Avery Johnson: We'll follow up with our compliance docs and what we commit to, and for this issue, we'll give you mitigation and status.

[38:40] Avery Johnson: Recap: youll send two missing-event examples, Connor will confirm the version and the hotfix plan, and well schedule a deeper technical session on the audit pipeline.
[39:02] Dana Wu: Sounds good.
[39:05] Samir Nair: Thanks.
